skill.name: kuaishou-topic-analysis
skill.description: Uses SocialDataX hot-search rankings and video search results to help creators, content teams, and brand researchers plan Kuaishou videos.
skill.summary: Find Kuaishou trends and video examples to plan short-form content.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are Markdown formatting or references, not shell execution or secret disclosure. The documented CLI runs an unpinned package with access to SocialDataX credentials, and its search example does not ensure safe handling of user input. No embedded keys or attempts to manipulate the audit were found.

remediation.issue: Unpinned npm package runs in the credential-bearing environment
remediation.suggestion: Use a reviewed, version-pinned CLI with verified dependency integrity. Remove automatic package installation from authentication and search instructions.

remediation.issue: Shell example does not establish safe keyword handling
remediation.suggestion: Pass keywords as separate process arguments without a shell, or use the structured MCP tool. Do not construct shell commands from user text.

remediation.issue: CLI reads credentials from the environment or a local JSON file
remediation.suggestion: Prefer an OS credential store or deployment secret manager. Pass only the required service credential to the verified CLI and document exact fallback variables.

content.user_title: Analyze Kuaishou Topics for Short Videos
content.value_statement: It takes time to tell which Kuaishou trends fit your audience. Use hot-search rankings and relevant video samples to identify ideas worth testing.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve Kuaishou hot-search topics, rankings, and available popularity signals.
Search Kuaishou videos by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or a configured MCP connection.
Limit CLI searches by page count or item count and continue an existing search when a cursor is available.
Report available titles, creators, video links or IDs, and visible engagement metrics.
Summarize recurring content angles and separate suggested ideas from observed evidence.
limitations: Live data requires an authenticated SocialDataX connection and may consume service credits.
Search results are samples, not a complete inventory of Kuaishou videos.
The workflow does not publish, like, comment, or change Kuaishou accounts.
Ranking and engagement signals do not predict how a new video will perform.

use_cases.title: Choose a video topic
use_cases.description: Review examples for one topic and choose a distinct angle for your next Kuaishou video.

use_cases.title: Plan a weekly publishing schedule
use_cases.description: Compare current hot-search topics with relevant videos and shortlist ideas for the next week.

use_cases.title: Review a product category
use_cases.description: Sample videos from a category and document recurring approaches with links or IDs for review.

prompt_templates.title: Review current trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the first five available Kuaishou hot-search topics. Include their ranks and any reported popularity signals.

prompt_templates.title: Sample a single topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Kuaishou for quick breakfast ideas. Review one page and report relevant titles, creators, and video links or IDs when available.

prompt_templates.title: Compare two angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare balcony gardening and indoor herb growing on Kuaishou. Review one page per keyword, then separate recurring video formats from your recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Build a research brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: collect a bounded sample and report gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the authorized CLI to sample Kuaishou videos about budget home cooking, with a limit of three pages or 30 items. Report recurring angles and cite representative videos. Mark partial results clearly and do not restart from the first page.

output_examples.input: Summarize three hot-search topics and suggest one angle for a food creator.
output: Illustrative trend summary: Spring outings ranked first, packed lunches ranked second, and balcony gardening ranked third.
Suggested angle: Show a packed lunch for a spring outing. This is a recommendation, not a measured trend for that specific video.

output_examples.input: Review a bounded sample of Kuaishou videos about indoor herb growing.
output: Illustrative partial result: Eight videos were available before the service returned an error.
Observed angles: Several videos focus on windowsill placement or watering routines.
Suggested test: Compare two windowsill setups. The sample does not establish which approach performs better.

best_practices: Start with one page and increase the scope only when more evidence is needed.
Keep video links or IDs for claims that reviewers need to verify.
Separate rankings and visible engagement from your interpretation.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into prompts, command arguments, or logs.
Do not treat a small or partial sample as representative of all Kuaishou content.
Do not automatically restart a partial search from the first page.

faq.question: What data does the skill use?
faq.answer: It uses Kuaishou hot-search rankings and video search results available through SocialDataX.

faq.question: Do I need a local API key?
faq.answer: A configured hosted MCP connection can use its existing authentication. The CLI needs a SocialDataX credential in its execution environment.

faq.question: Can searches use service credits?
faq.answer: Yes. Set a page or item limit before expanding a search.

faq.question: How do I verify a video example?
faq.answer: Ask for the video link or ID and any available title, creator, or engagement metrics.

faq.question: What happens if a search stops early?
faq.answer: The report should mark the sample as partial. Resume only when the service supplies a cursor and the original limits still permit more results.

faq.question: Can the skill publish videos or change my account?
faq.answer: No. The documented Kuaishou workflow retrieves data for research and does not perform account actions.
